import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Fix species label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip()
    # Fix island label variant
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.title()
    # Convert flipper_length_mm from text to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to numeric (remove commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    # Keep sex as is (missing is allowed, per rules)
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by sex and compute average body mass
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    # Drop missing group keys (if any)
    result = {k: v for k, v in result.items() if pd.notna(v)}
    # Add overall average
    overall_avg = df['body_mass_g'].mean()
    result['all'] = overall_avg
    return result
